sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Ludington State Park campsites via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-09-21; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-22)

values.note: Same in all three campgrounds (Beechwood, Cedar, Pines). 2027 on the booking site (2027-05-18, 07-13 and 09-21 alike): 20/30-amp sites $48, 50-amp sites $53 (Beechwood and Pines only; Cedar has no 50-amp). The DNR's 2026 table: $45 / $50; Cedar, open year-round, is $40 semi-modern while its shower building is closed (open April 1 - Oct 31). Cedar's 8 tent-only sites $43 (2027) and the 10 Jackpine hike-in tent sites $20 are left out. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ feeDetails per fee schedule ($48 for 117 Beechwood, 74 Pines and 106 Cedar 20/30-amp sites and $53 for 30 Beechwood and 25 Pines 50-amp sites on 2027-05-18 / 07-13 / 09-21; $45 / $50 on 2026-10-27; Cedar tent-only $43, Jackpine $20) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Beechwood $50 / $45; Cedar $45 modern, $40 semi-modern, $20 rustic, shower building April 1 to Oct. 31; Pines $50 / $45) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/ludington, read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/ludington (Beechwood: 'There is 20/30 amp service available at each site, and some sites offer 50-amp service'; Pines: 'some sites with 50-amp'; Cedar: '20/30-amp service available on each site') + midnrreservations.com site attributes (all modern sites 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only', 'Sewer Hookup=No'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Three drive-in campgrounds: Beechwood 147 sites (back, middle and front loops, generous and shaded, near Hamlin Lake), Pines 99 (two loops, modest and heavily shaded, near Lake Michigan, trailhead to Big Sable Point Lighthouse), Cedar 114 (east and west loops, generous, some sunny; 8 of them tent-only). All allow trailers/RVs to 40 ft. Plus 10 Jackpine walk-in tent sites (~1-mile hike).

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/ludington ('Number of sites: 147' / '99' / '114, including eight tent-only sites'; 'Pull-through sites available' in each; Jackpine 'Number of sites: 10') + midnrreservations.com resources (equipment to 'Trailer or RV up to 40'' in all three), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/ludington ('Toilet & shower building', 'Vault toilet', 'Sanitation station' in each campground; 'The park's sanitation station ... There is potable water available and four lanes'; Cedar 'Concession or store', Dune Grass Concessions at the Cedar entrance) + DNR rates page ('Modern campgrounds include flush toilets, showers, a sanitation station'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/ludington (each campground: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-22

summary: DNR park page + booking site + DNR rates table: three modern campgrounds (Beechwood 147, Pines 99, Cedar 114 incl. 8 tent-only), 20/30 A everywhere and 50 A at some Beechwood and Pines sites, electric only, pull-throughs, RVs to 40 ft, showers/flush and vault toilets/sanitation station with potable water, store. Fees 20-50 (2026 table, low was the Jackpine hike-in tent rate) -> 48-53 (2027 booking site, same in all three loops; 2026 $45/$50 and Cedar's $40 winter semi-modern rate in the note; Recreation Passport in fees.note). Season (manual, per-campground) left as is. --AWH note kept unchanged.
flags: Pin: 44.0515,-86.4945 sits in the wooded dunes roughly 1.5 km north of the campground loops along the Big Sable River and on none of the three campgrounds (Beechwood, Cedar, Pines) on satellite imagery (Esri, read 2026-10-22); it should be moved onto one of them (the drive-in campgrounds are north of the river, e.g. the loops near 44.037,-86.502).
